profile.short_tagline: I build calibrated, probabilistic machine learning systems and own them in production: real-time pricing, transit-time prediction, recommendations, and demand forecasting. I also build the agentic tooling and experimentation workflows that help teams ship.
profile.current_role: Currently a Senior Data Scientist at Arrive Logistics, working on quantile pricing and offer automation for truckload freight.
profile.availability: I'm open to senior IC roles in applied ML, data, and AI engineering, and to scoped consulting work.

about: I'm a full-stack data scientist and ML engineer with over a decade of production ownership experience. At Coyote Logistics I worked on real-time freight pricing and load matching. At ShipBob I owned the ML platform powering forecasting, delivery-time prediction, and inventory optimization. Today I work on truckload pricing and offer automation at Arrive Logistics.

Most of my work is probabilistic: quantile regression, conformal calibration, and forecasting at scale. I work on problems where the data is noisy, confidence matters, and outcomes move the bottom line. I design the backtesting and simulation infrastructure to prove a model works before it ships. I believe in end-to-end ownership, from feature pipelines to distributed API services to the interfaces leadership uses to make decisions.
Outside work I build complete products on the same stack, from open-source prediction benchmarks and sports data products to crypto research tooling.
